explanation.value: What a node needs depends only on the state it inherits from the nearest operation above it: off (decrypted) or on (encrypted). Define cost(node, s) as the minimum operations inside the node's subtree given inherited state s. A file costs 0 if its flag equals s and 1 otherwise (one operation on the file fixes it). For a directory, either leave it alone, so children inherit s and the cost is the sum of children at s, or operate on it to switch to the other state, costing 1 plus the sum of children at not s. Operating to set the same state as inherited is never useful. The root inherits off, so the answer is cost(root, off). Computing both states bottom-up is linear.
